capabilities: Query the plugin catalog with a JQL-style query language
Track 7- and 30-day download growth, milestones and release cadence
Surface dormant plugins that ship a new version
Find similar plugins by description, category and tags
Save plugins as Markdown library notes with frontmatter and Bases views
disambiguation: Not an indexer for your own notes; it indexes and tracks Obsidian's community plugin catalog.
extras: Initial sync downloads about 3 MB of catalog, release archive and similarity data; no accounts or telemetry; detailed query, library-note and settings references live in separate guides.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in plugin browser is great for installing a plugin when you already know its name
motivation: The author found that all-time download rankings bury new momentum, frequent patchers drown out real comebacks, and 'I'll try this later' bookmarks get lost.
problem: The built-in plugin browser only helps when you already know a plugin's name, and all-time download counts hide which plugins are actually rising or reviving.

relations.evidence: Syncs fetch static public files from GitHub.
Connect Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, or OpenRouter via Obsidian's native keychain

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini or OpenRouter API key

summary: Dashboard and query engine over Obsidian's community plugin catalog that tracks growth, comebacks and alternatives and saves picks as vault notes.
